tool_summary: Adds a third-party APT repository (PPA or custom source) to the system's package sources, expanding the set of sources apt will trust for future installs and upgrades.
platform_notes: add-apt-repository is Debian/Ubuntu-specific (part of software-properties-common). A separate binary from apt itself.

rules.description: Adds a repository as a trusted package source. An untrusted or unfamiliar repository (especially a third-party PPA) is a common supply-chain attack vector, since packages installed from it run arbitrary maintainer scripts with root privileges at install time.
rules.reversible_note: The source entry can be removed with --remove, but any packages already installed from it in the meantime are not automatically uninstalled.
